paragraphs.text:
Huddled  in  dank  darkness,  the  two  of  you  hide  from  the 
creatures outside. You hear many pairs of strange feet scuttling, 
close by.

Make a Stealth roll for Norman and yourself: if you both succeed, go 
to 334; if either of you fails, go to 335.
